name: TOI-700
why: Red dwarf with several known planets, including Earth-sized TOI-700 d in the habitable zone.

name: Pi Mensae
why: Bright Sun-like star; its transiting super-Earth was one of TESS's first discoveries.

name: Kepler-10
why: Host of Kepler-10b, Kepler's first confirmed rocky planet. Good test for Kepler data.
